# Shilika Jain — Fractional PR for Web3 & AI Founders

> Shilika Jain is a fractional PR manager who places Web3, AI, and cybersecurity founders into Tier-1 publications (Forbes, CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block, Blockworks, AI Magazine) and runs APAC localisation across Korea, Japan, Vietnam, China, and India. Six years of practice. 50+ protocols shaped. 100K+ media mentions per quarter across the network. Direct line to 200+ vetted Web3 KOLs.

She is the operator behind front-page placements for Gaia AI ("the Stripe for AI agents," Forbes + Decrypt + Benzinga), RARI Foundation (11 simultaneous Tier-1 placements on mainnet launch), MANTRA Chain (the $11M raise narrative with a Middle East angle), Fluence Network (DePIN category creation), Web3Auth (Google Cloud × Firebase story), and Bullieverse, among others. She currently leads APAC PR & partnerships at Myosin, a growth-marketing DAO, and was previously at CoinMarketCap.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.shilikajain.com/): Services, case studies, press features, contact. The canonical overview of Shilika's fractional PR practice.
- [Blog](https://www.shilikajain.com/blog): Long-form playbooks on Web3 and AI PR, founder profiling, APAC strategy, and Tier-1 media access.

## Playbooks

- [The Tier-1 trap: why most Web3 founders chase the wrong publications](https://www.shilikajain.com/article-1): An 8-minute breakdown of why a Forbes mention can be worse than a niche placement, and how to read which publications actually move a roadmap.
- [Korea, Japan, Vietnam: the APAC PR playbook nobody hands you](https://www.shilikajain.com/article-2): An 11-minute regional teardown — which outlets matter in BloomingBit, CryptoTimes JP, ChainCatcher, Jinse; how to pitch them; what most agencies get wrong.
- [From technical founder to category voice: a 90-day profiling sprint](https://www.shilikajain.com/article-3): A 6-minute founder profiling sprint — cadence, calendar, and the four hand-offs that turn a technical founder into a category-defining voice.

## Services

- **Strategic PR Campaigns**: press releases, embargo strategy, crisis communications, sentiment reporting.
- **Founder Profiling & Op-Eds**: op-ed ghostwriting, podcast tours, speaker placement, LinkedIn/X strategy.
- **KOL & Influencer Marketing**: campaign design, creator vetting, performance tracking, token-launch operations across 200+ vetted Web3 creators.
- **APAC Localisation & Access**: native translation, regional KOLs, on-ground events, local journalist databases across Korea, Japan, Vietnam, China, India.
- **GTM for Early-Stage Web3**: TGE communications, exchange relations (Binance, OKX, MEXC), community seeding, SEO link-building.
